summary: Exercise the reconnect contract and record which half this machine could actually reach

coordination.notes: Appended to the existing B3 record rather than starting a second verification file, so there is one account of this chain rather than two that will disagree.

checks: Godot half, proven: viewer opened from Settings (pid 36204), killed by that pid, relaunched (pid 35100, a new process), and its window again read Empaths' Guild / 1-308. A watching client's whole log across the episode was three lines ending 'snapshot sequence 5 room 1-308', so nothing new was published and the room on screen came from the held snapshot handed over at auth.
a second client connecting minutes after the publish also received sequence 5 on auth, which is the same contract from the other side

Lich half, NOT reached: Detach then Attach produced 'client detached' / 'client attached' in the fixture and game_status connected with 16 lines, and no snapshot reached the bridge. justReconnected follows bridgeConnected, which is the companion-bridge plugin socket on 7415, not the game socket Attach opens - tools/fake-lich.mjs provides only the latter, so the forced-publish path could not have fired whatever happened. Recorded as unexercised rather than as a pass or a defect: the room did not change, so deduplication was also correct.
